name: Perdura
description: [Collaborated] Long-horizon agents must generate code, invoke tools, and incorporate feedback across extended tasks. Many existing harnesses leave part of this execution continuity in the model-visible interaction history, requiring the model to recover prior outcomes, available computational state, and unfinished work as trajectories grow. We propose Perdura, a stateful execution harness that makes the division of responsibility between the model and runtime explicit. The model expresses executable actions through a Python interface, while the runtime preserves persistent computational state, durable execution evidence, and unfinished work across steps, exposing only bounded state projections to the model and restoring committed state after waiting or interruption.
